# fopost_labels (Data Source)

Lists the FoPost labels the API key can reach. Use it to reference labels created outside this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fopost_labels" "acme" {
  workspace_id = "ws_01hzy8example"
}

output "label_names" {
  value = [for label in data.fopost_labels.acme.labels : label.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) Narrow the list to one workspace. Omit it to list every label the API key can reach.

### Read-Only

- `labels` (Attributes List) The labels, in the order the API returned them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Hex color the label is drawn in.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the label was created.
- `id` (String) The label's identifier.
- `name` (String) Display name of the label.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the label.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the label belongs to.
